newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Diana to visit Pakistan to help cancer hospital.
newsitem.headline: Diana to visit Pakistan to help cancer hospital.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana will begin a three-day visit to Pakistan on Thursday to help raise funds for a cancer hospital in Lahore, capital of the central province of Punjab, hospital sources said on Monday.
The visit will be her second to Pakistan in 15 months to help the Shaukat Khanum Memorial Hospital built by former cricket captain turned politician Imran Khan.
Diana will attend a tea party on Friday and a dinner the next day to help raise funds for the hospital, the sources said.
The princess last visited Lahore in February, 1996 before Imran Khan launched his Tehrik-i-Insaaf party, which failed to win a single parliamentary seat in general elections held earlier this year.
